newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tatneft did ADR placement -- broker.
newsitem.headline: Tatneft did ADR placement -- broker.

text.p: Russian regional oil company Tatneft carried out a private placement of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) last week covering 10 percent of its capital or 2.33 million shares, a dealer at its Russian market-maker IFK Solid said on Monday.
Pavel Gotsev told Reuters the placement, under the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's rule 144a/s, was made at around $45 a share, with one ADR equivalent to one share.
The placement was made through Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, he said.
AO Tatneft conducted a road-show ending last week and has said it is planning to issue level-three ADRs.

But the company has not yet produced three years of accounts audited to international standards required by the SEC, and the latest placement appeared to be a further issue of the ADRs already outstanding in Berlin, Frankfurt and the NASDAQ bulletin board.

Before the latest placement Tatneft's biggest shareholders were the government of Russia's autonomous republic of Tatarstan, with 41.00 percent, workforce and management 41.34 percent and customers and suppliers with 3.66 percent.
Tatneft was $44.00 at 1000 GMT, up from $42.10 at Friday's close.
